Italian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /tesˈta.ta/
  • Rhymes: -ata
  • Hyphenation: te‧stà‧ta

Etymology 1

[edit]

From testa (“head”) +‎ -ata.

Noun

[edit]

testata f (plural testate)

  1. headbutt
    Synonym: craniata
  2. head (of a valley, column, etc.)
  3. (architecture) the access point of a longitudinal structure; front, head
    Synonym: fronte
    la testata di un aeroporto ― the front of an airport
    la testata del ponte ― the head of the bridge
  4. (weaponry) warhead
  5. cylinder head
  6. masthead, headline (in a newspaper)
  7. (metonymic) newspaper
  8. bedhead, headboard

Etymology 2

[edit]

Participle

[edit]

testata f sg

  1. feminine singular of testato

Anagrams

[edit]
  • attesta, settata, tastate
